settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: A: I'm always cold. Literally always. The room temperature is always a topic of discussion whether it's at home with my husband or my colleagues at work. So you can imagine what winters do to me. That's when I tried the heated Apparel from Venustas and I'm a happy camper.

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: A: This is my first time using a heated vest. I've always been inquisitive about them and it got me through a very cold hike to Machu Picchu!

settings.heading: Q4: How do you feel about Venustas heated apparel?
settings.body: A: I love that I have the option to just wear the jacket, or turn on the heat options at various levels based on how cold it is. I just feel like I have a lot more control!

settings.heading: Q5: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body: A: I think I'm going to be using heated vests for a long time given how comfortable and fuzzy they make me feel. The customer care has been on point and I've really enjoyed working with Venustas!
